title: EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging

triage.reason: The European Commission launched a public consultation (21 Oct 2026 – 13 Jan 2027) on a planned regulation setting EU rules and targets for biobased feedstock in plastic packaging under the packaging and packaging waste framework.

draft.summary: A public consultation on EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging, reference Ares(2026)9620334, is open for feedback from 21 October 2026 to 13 January 2027. The initiative is listed with an active status and a foreseen act type of PROP_REG, covering targets for biobased feedstock and relevant requirements.

key_dates.text: Feedback period on EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging opens.

draft.interpretation: Rules on biobased feedstock would sit alongside the recycled-content requirements already being elaborated, so packaging producers may need to document both fossil-based recycled content and bio-based content in future. Respondents have until 13 January 2027 to shape the feedstock targets and requirements that would apply.
